I made this as a parody of the corporate layoff victory lap. Experienced workers know markets, customers, and pain points. AI can cut the time and expense of launching a small business. Gusto's 2026 founder survey found 50% reported faster or cheaper starts with AI. Some former employees may become competitors. That's a risk worth discussing, without pretending every layoff leads to a startup.
